Based on my search, no document in this collection specifies arbitration seated in Singapore. The only arbitration clause found is in **msa-2019.pdf** (page containing clause 14.3), which states that disputes are to be resolved by arbitration seated in **London** under the LCIA, not Singapore.

NOT FOUND — I searched all contracts, correspondence, pleadings, depositions, and exhibits (using "Singapore," "SIAC," and "arbitrat*") and found no reference to Singapore-seated arbitration. The only arbitration clause present is in msa-2019.pdf, which specifies London (LCIA) as the seat.
